caption: The drawing features a central figure riding a blue horse. The figure has a blue body and is draped in a red-orange cloak and wears a crown. The figure is holding what appears to be a staff or scepter in its extended right arm. The background is a light brown or tan wash, forming a square with faint organic textures. Decorative motifs are present within the border, including black lines, spiral shapes, stylized flowers, a crescent shape, a sun-like form with triangular rays, and various geometric patterns. At the top center, there is a triangular arrangement above the seated figure containing a brown cross, bordered with smaller black detailing and decorated with small fronds and flower motifs. The entire composition is contained within a square in the center of a larger blank white rectangular page.
title: St. George (Painted on Deerskin)
